description.it: I giocatori più preziosi e i migliori a fine contratto.
description.en: The most valuable players and the best ones near the end of their contract.

title.it: I 20 giocatori con il valore più alto

widgets.sql: SELECT name, transfer_value FROM players WHERE transfer_value IS NOT NULL ORDER BY transfer_value DESC LIMIT 20

title.it: In scadenza entro 6 mesi (per abilità attuale)

widgets.sql: SELECT p.name, p.age, p.club_name, p.natural_positions AS positions, p.ability_current, p.ability_potential, c."end" AS contract_end, c.wage, p.transfer_value FROM players p JOIN contracts c ON c.player_uid = p.uid WHERE c."end" <= date(:today, '+6 months') ORDER BY p.ability_current DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT name, age, club_name, loan_parent_club_name AS owner_club, loan_end, ability_current, ability_potential FROM players WHERE on_loan = 1 ORDER BY ability_current DESC LIMIT 100
